data_scope: Authored synthetic fixtures; no actual customer databases or freight records

rules.columns: Canonical English headers, UTF-8 comma-separated CSV or first XLSX worksheet; header order/case ignored.
rules.dates: ISO only. Naive timestamps are UTC; offsets convert to UTC. Date-only means 00:00 UTC, NOT end of day. Convert local time / end-of-day promises explicitly before upload.
rules.duplicates: Snapshot table, not an event feed. First occurrence wins; later duplicate IDs excluded. Review conflicts before confirming; no latest-event inference.
rules.currency: USD only, no FX. If currency/shipping_currency/cost_currency is supplied, every supplied column must say USD on that row. Blank/non-USD costs excluded. Without currency metadata you confirm costs have already been converted to USD.
rules.numbers: US number convention: 1,234 = 1234, decimal point is '.'. No automatic unit/FX conversion.
rules.context: V2 needs additional delay/financial/dependency evidence; absent evidence remains insufficient information. V3 remains a separate synthetic scenario.

source_declarations.source_label: Synthetic template example: 2 shipments (not real business data)
policy: USD / kg / m3 / h only. No FX or unit inference/conversion. Decimal point numbers only.
Offset-aware ISO timestamps required; date-only/naive dates rejected. Every order starts at the common planning_start.
Shared service IDs share weight, volume and slots, with one common expected transit duration. Capacity is not repeated per order.
Capacity without any quoted option is retained in source records but omitted from the model; utilization denominators cover modeled services only.
Expected-time deadlines are hard eligibility constraints, not arrival guarantees. Demands/costs round up, capacities/budget/deadlines down to the existing solver units.
estimate and user_verified are uploader declarations with references, not independent verification by this app.
No historical distribution is imported: no Monte Carlo, real on-time probability or risk preference in Uploaded Data Mode.
Imports are immutable snapshots. Correct the source and create a new import to change inputs.
source_declarations.reliability: Not estimated. No historical distribution provided; internal zero std is a deterministic solver placeholder, not measured reliability.
